$comment: Single source of truth for the bb UI components each plugin vendors. scripts/vendor-ui.mjs owns plugins/*/src/vendor/ outright and is its only writer; a hand-edit, or any file in there no closure explains, fails npm run check:ui. Compose around a component instead of editing it — bb exports the seams (CompactViewportOverrideProvider, ResponsiveDrawerShell, MobileTrigger, stripRadixContentProps, MENU_ITEM_LAST_HOVERED_CLASS, LIST_HOVER_TRANSITION).
